messages:
Sam H: quick sync — ACME POC alignment. Need to lock success criteria, eval harness prompts, scoring rubric, timeline, and any security blockers. Can we run a short checklist here?

Maria C: use cases we agreed on: 1) support summarization (short answers), 2) contract field extraction (structured JSON), 3) results re-ranking. Recommend separate prompt/eval sets per use case.

Alex P: FYI customer asks: p95 chat latency < 300ms, baseline throughput ~20 req/s. Also they want a cost estimate for ~100k requests/month. @Jen T can you ballpark hosted vs dedicated?

Jen T: hosted ballpark we'll provide once we have token estimate. Dedicated needs a monthly commit — I'll surface numbers after Alex shares token profile. Also received their security questionnaire — SSO, KMS, and retention Qs are outstanding.

Lee R: notes on eval harness format: CSV or JSONL with columns: prompt, expected_output, eval_type. Eval types = exact_match, slot_f1, normalized_bleu, hallucination_flag. Harness should emit daily regression reports + diffs.

Sam H: sample prompt payload (for harness ingestion):
```json
{"prompt": "Summarize the support thread in 1-2 sentences.", "context": "[ticket text]", "metadata": {"case_id":"1234"}}
```
Keep examples minimal.

Maria C: golden dataset guidance: aim for 200 high-quality examples per use case to start. Include edge cases and adversarial queries. Reserve ~20% as regression holdout. Label expected outputs and allowed variants.

Alex P: propose regression gates: absolute drop >3 percentage points in pass-rate over golden set OR exact-match drop >2% triggers rollback/canary. Also surface hallucination rate; if >1% for production-critical intents, auto-notify. Alerts to #incidents + oncall.

Jen T: security blockers list I need to close: SOC2/SOC report copy, data flow diagram, retention & deletion policy, KMS integration details, contractual DPA redlines. @Lee R can you draft a minimal architecture/dataflow we can send?

Lee R: yes — I’ll produce a redacted dataflow diagram and a short write-up about encryption keys + KMS (we support customer-managed keys + provider KMS). Will also include a sample minimal config for prompt templates and model selection (example: `model: redwood-small-q4`, `batching: true`, `kv_cache: enabled`).

Sam H: suggested timeline:
- week0: kickoff + data access
- week1: eval harness + ingest golden prompts
- week2: run baseline + perf tests
- week3: iterate prompts and config tuning
- week4: final report + handover
This is a 4-week scoping with weekly checkpoints.

Maria C: draft acceptance criteria per use case: functional coverage >= 90% on golden set; p95 latency <= 300ms; hallucination rate <1%; cost <= customer target (TBD). Also require regression CI — harness must block merges if gate fails.

Alex P: I'll put together a quick perf/load plan and token estimation by Thursday. Will include expected avg tokens/req and burst profile.

Jen T: I'll lead security Q responses and SOW redlines. Legal will need the DPA template; I'll ping them.

Sam H: action items recap:
- Lee R: redacted dataflow + harness template by EOD Tue
- Maria C: finalize golden prompts (initial 200 per use case) by Wed
- Alex P: perf plan + token/cost estimate by Thu
- Jen T: security questionnaire answers + DPA touchpoint by Fri
Please ack on this thread.

Maria C: ack — I’ll start curating examples today.

Lee R: ack — drafting diagram now.

Alex P: ack, will share perf plan in #eng-runtime tomorrow.

Jen T: ack — I'll coordinate with legal and loop back.

infra-bot: deploy job #742 succeeded to staging (timestamp 1867890700) — just noting that staging is ready if you want to smoke test.

Sam H: perfect. Thanks all — we'll turn this into the POC checklist doc after thread. :thumbsup:
